_comment: One entry per minimal recorded sequence. 'history' is relative to this folder; 'bugs' are the discovered bugs the sequence guards. expect = 'known-bugs': the bugs are still open, so every listed bug must still show up. expect = 'clean': the bugs are fixed, so none of the listed bugs may show up. A fix therefore turns a 'known-bugs' entry red on purpose: change it to 'clean'. If a bug is fixed in the version under development but still present on the hosted site, give 'expect' per environment, e.g. {"hosted": "known-bugs", "local": "clean"}; CI tests the local build. Other discovered bugs in the same replay are only reported. Make a sequence with: python -m tests.cli reduce (or --bug <id>), replay it 5 times (--repeat 5), and add it here only if all 5 agree.
